messages.author: hana
messages.text: Good morning — the test in the session refresh suite failed again on CI overnight. It passed locally for me twice. Has anyone else seen it? 🙏

messages.author: omar
messages.text:
yeah it's a clock race, the test asserts on the token expiry before the fake clock advances. look:
```
it('refreshes near expiry', () => {
  advanceClock(0)
  expect(token.expiresIn).toBe(300)
})
```
it needs to advance past the skew first. i'll push a fix after standup

messages.author: hana
messages.text: Ah, that explains it — thank you for digging in! I'll re-trigger the pipeline once your fix lands.

messages.author: omar
messages.text: 👍 will drop the PR link here when it's up
